verdict: Paid ads have been paused since mid-September; local visibility is fading.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Meta ads ran briefly before pausing on September 16, leaving no active paid engine for the remainder of the period. Your Google Business Profile generated 165 actions — 75 calls, 59 direction requests, and 31 website clicks — but local visibility dropped sharply in the last 7 days, with three consecutive days of near-zero activity. Lead tracking is also showing a gap: your CRM recorded 149 contacts this period while paid channels show zero attributed leads, and we are actively repairing that attribution connection so the scoreboard reflects reality. Reactivating paid campaigns and stabilising local search are the immediate priorities heading into the next period.
